task.pr_title: fix(datadog_traces sink): APM stats payloads are sent independent of trace payloads and at a set interval.

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: I think we should also be breaking here? If the tripwire signal is terminal (i.e. we `break`) when sent correctly, we would conceivably want to shutdown if the tripwire channel was closed: it's not like it's gonna actually ever _come back_.
